summary: 5-8 service cards stand on a slowly tilted 3D drum (CSS 3D). The front card faces the visitor; the cards beside it curve away and fade. A numbered scale of service names above the drum (APG tabs) and previous/next buttons below it turn the drum to the chosen card. When the section is first seen the drum turns in from a brand-seeded offset; tilt, turn direction and card spacing are seeded from the brand name. Phones get a plain list. Needs 5-8 real service lines; with 3-4 use services-tabs or services-bento.
